title: Connect Japanese localization to executable Wizard entrypoints
rawUserRequest: Japanese capability is mandatory because most adopter engineers use Japanese. Correct every issue found by the comprehensive Japanese assessment before documentation alignment or release, using a separate complete Work Item lifecycle for each issue.

declaredIntent.summary: Provide executable Japanese interaction for both governed Wizard entrypoints without changing evidence or control semantics.

outOfScope: Translating repository evidence, detected project facts, paths, commands, or user-supplied values.
Changing CalibrationSession state transitions, installer transactions, confirmation authority, or activation rules.
Claiming general Japanese model fluency or human translation quality.
Fixing JA-STATUS-001, JA-PR-001, JA-LIFECYCLE-001, or JA-DOC-001 in this Work Item.
Starting documentation alignment, deprecated-assets cleanup, or release.

sources.reason: JA-CLI-001 records that executable Wizard entrypoints do not consume the Japanese resource layer.
The executable installation Wizard currently renders its interaction chrome and confirmations in English.
The executable calibration Wizard currently renders commands, prompts, states, and recovery messages in English.
The strict locale normalization and resource loader already exist but are not connected to executable entrypoints.
The Japanese resource currently has exact parity but only seven generic keys.
WI-16 requires each Japanese blocker to be corrected serially through a complete lifecycle.

riskAssessment.reason: Incorrect localization can obscure fail-closed confirmation and recovery semantics or clear the release blocker on static imports alone.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized correction of every Japanese assessment finding and continuous execution.

preReviewWarnings: Review exact Japanese meaning for confirmation, STOP, pause, recovery, Unknown, and N/A boundaries.
Verify both executable Wizard entrypoints consume resources; one static import is insufficient.
Keep paths, commands, identifiers, and evidence values byte-preserving.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Both installation and calibration Wizard executable entrypoints resolve an explicit language, AI_COCKPIT_LANGUAGE, system locale, and the safe Japanese default through ai_wizard_localization.
Both CLI parsers expose --language in help output and reject unsupported language values instead of silently falling back.

All user-visible Wizard interaction chrome needed for selection, plan review, confirmation, blocking, pause/recovery, command navigation, Unknown, and N/A is rendered from exact-parity ja/en/zh-CN resources.

Japanese executable tests assert Japanese prompts and output for installation and calibration, including declined confirmation, dry run, blocked readiness, pause/recovery, unknown command, and summary rendering.
Paths, commands, stage IDs, statuses, detected facts, user answers, and machine evidence remain unchanged values and are not machine-translated.
The Japanese assessor requires both executable entrypoints plus Japanese behavior tests before JA-CLI-001 can pass; an import-only or single-entrypoint implementation remains blocking.
The machine JSON and derived Markdown Japanese assessment are regenerated; JA-CLI-001 passes while the other four corrective findings remain blocking.
Architecture documentation states the executable localization boundary and does not claim general Japanese fluency.
Full local finish/archive, one PR, Hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, synchronized clean main, and assessment refresh complete before JA-STATUS-001 begins.
guidelines: Use one strict resource layer for both Wizard entrypoints and preserve exact key/placeholder parity.
Localize presentation chrome only; never translate or alter evidence-bearing values.
Keep confirmation and failure paths fail closed in every supported locale.
Test executable behavior rather than accepting resource-file or import presence as capability evidence.
Record assessment changes and remaining blockers without overclaiming Japanese readiness.

intent.problem: AI Cockpit has Japanese Wizard message resources, but neither executable installation nor calibration Wizard consumes them. Japanese adopters therefore receive English-only interaction and static resource parity can be mistaken for working Japanese capability.
constraints: Preserve installer and CalibrationSession authority and all fail-closed write boundaries.
Do not translate evidence values, paths, commands, IDs, statuses, or user input.
Keep ja, en, and zh-CN keys and placeholders exactly aligned.
Require executable tests for both entrypoints before clearing JA-CLI-001.
Leave all unrelated Japanese blockers active and complete this Work Item lifecycle before the next corrective.
intent.rationale: Connecting one shared strict localization layer to both executable Wizard paths provides deterministic Japanese interaction without duplicating business logic or making unsupported fluency claims.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Japanese adopter runs either Wizard without a language option or with --language ja-JP.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The executable resolves ja and renders Japanese interaction chrome while preserving evidence values.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add red-first executable tests for both entrypoints using the default and ja-JP alias, then assert Japanese prompts/output and unchanged paths, IDs, and facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A caller requests an unsupported language.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The entrypoint exits non-zero with an explicit unsupported-language error and never silently falls back or mutates the target.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add CLI and unit regressions for unsupported language resolution before implementing argument wiring.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Japanese installation is declined, dry-run, or blocked by missing readiness evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Japanese STOP/cancel/read-only text is shown and the installer is never invoked before affirmative confirmation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend installation Wizard tests across decline, dry-run, and blocked paths with Japanese output and write-boundary assertions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Japanese calibration session pauses, receives an unknown command, or displays Unknown/N/A evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Japanese recovery and navigation chrome is rendered while CalibrationSession state, answer types, and fail-closed activation rules remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend calibration Wizard tests for render, command loop, EOF/pause, unknown command, and summary behavior.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Only one Wizard imports localization or resources exist without executable assertions.
scenarioCoverage.expected: JA-CLI-001 remains blocking and release preflight cannot treat the capability as implemented.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Strengthen the assessor and its tests to require both entrypoints and named executable Japanese test evidence.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized all Japanese capability corrections before release and continuous execution.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
